major_cooldowns.name: Adrenaline Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown at 2 or fewer combo points, then follow it with Killing Spree.

major_cooldowns.name: Roll the Bones
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Reroll on cooldown whenever your current roll is at stage 1 or lower; do not reroll a stage 3 or higher roll.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Two live ids share this name; 1214909 is the one seen in casts, so it is used over the uncast 315508.

major_cooldowns.name: Between the Eyes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it every time it is off cooldown once you have 6 or more combo points.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown; it fits into the priority above Between the Eyes and Dispatch.

major_cooldowns.name: Killing Spree
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as a finisher right after Adrenaline Rush comes off cooldown. If Between the Eyes is also ready at the same time, Supercharge it first so Killing Spree gets the damage bonus too.

major_cooldowns.name: Keep It Rolling
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it any time your Roll the Bones is at stage 3 or higher (stage 2 or higher with Fatebound) so its long cooldown is not wasted.

major_cooldowns.name: Preparation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it once Between the Eyes, Adrenaline Rush, and Killing Spree are all on cooldown, and aim the reset at a burn phase or add phase without holding it long enough to lose a cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Flurry
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Turn it on once 2 or more targets are in range and it is not already active; recast it at 4 or fewer combo points once 4 or more targets are up.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to shed a dangerous magic effect or to walk through a heavy magic hit.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use it for heavy incoming melee or physical damage you cannot avoid.
defensives.id_note: Castable per its tooltip; seen in 2 of the 4 sampled parses.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to top off health whenever you take chip damage, since its short cooldown lets you use it often.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Press it ahead of a raid-wide or AoE hit for the area damage reduction.

rules.description: Open with Adrenaline Rush into Roll the Bones
rules.action: Open with Adrenaline Rush, then Roll the Bones, then build to 6 or more combo points before your first Between the Eyes.

rules.description: Killing Spree right after Adrenaline Rush
rules.action: Send Killing Spree as a finisher in the window right after Adrenaline Rush instead of banking it.

rules.description: Between the Eyes only at high combo points
rules.action: Only fire Between the Eyes at 6 or more combo points.

rules.description: Dispatch only at high combo points
rules.action: Only cast Dispatch at 6 or more combo points (5 or more with Fatebound).

rules.description: Do not overcap combo points with Sinister Strike
rules.action: Only press Sinister Strike at 5 or fewer combo points; spend a finisher above that instead.

rules.description: Spend Opportunity stacks with Pistol Shot
rules.action: Fire Pistol Shot once Opportunity reaches 6 stacks, or at 3 stacks while you are at 1-3 combo points, instead of letting it cap.

rules.description: Blade Flurry only with a second target in range
rules.action: Hold Blade Flurry until 2 or more targets are in range.
